title: Ideal Day Lab
domain: Design and rebalance one humane 24-hour day from real constraints.
scenario: Shape a weekday with eight hours of sleep, focused work, movement, meals, care, and unallocated breathing room.
steps: Open the intro and choose Start my day.
Create or adjust the sample blocks so the full day remains allocated.
Review the time ring and comparison insights, then save the plan or restart the day.
evidence: The edited 24-hour ring, one explicit tradeoff, and a reachable restart or saved-plan path.
